tagline: Trusted household help from your local cooperative

auth.welcomeSubtitle: Log in or create an account to get started

auth.resetCodeSent: Enter the code we sent to {}
auth.resetSuccess: Password updated. Log in with your new password.
auth.devOtpHint: SMS may be delayed. Use this code: {}

home.greeting: What do you need help with?
home.subtitle: Book a trusted worker from the cooperative
home.topRatedEmpty: Approved workers nearby will show up here.
home.locationHintBody: Turn on location for closer providers and better distance sorting.

booking.instantHint: A nearby worker will be assigned as soon as possible
booking.scheduledHint: Pick a date and time slot
booking.payHint: Pay securely with Razorpay after the job is done.
booking.payChoiceTitle: How would you like to pay?
booking.payChoiceHint: The job is done. Pay in the app, or pay the worker directly and they will confirm it.
booking.payDirectBody: Pay {} in cash or UPI. Nothing to submit here — they will tap Payment received on their app once they have the money.
booking.payWeb: Card checkout opens in the Android or iOS app. Use Try again on your phone.
booking.paymentCancelled: Payment was cancelled. You can try again.
booking.paymentNotConfigured: Razorpay is not configured for this booking yet.
booking.paymentIncomplete: Checkout did not return payment details. Try again.
booking.notesHint: e.g. Ceiling fan not spinning, 2nd floor
booking.noAddresses: Add an address and we’ll know where to send help.

tracking.title: Live tracking
tracking.waitingForWorker: Waiting for worker to start heading over
tracking.workerPending: We’ll show their name as soon as someone accepts
tracking.cancelBody: Cancel this booking? The worker will be notified.
tracking.callUnavailable: Calling is available after a worker is assigned.
tracking.callPlaced: Your phone will ring shortly. Answer to connect.
tracking.callDialFailed: Could not open the phone dialer.
tracking.chatEmpty: Say hello — your worker will see it here.
tracking.payOrCash: Pay in the app, or pay the worker in cash.

history.title: Your bookings

support.title: Support

language.title: Choose your language

providers.queueSubtitle: Review verified workers before you book.
providers.approveBody: Are you sure you want to approve {}? This will mark them as a trusted KRIYANTA worker.
providers.deactivateBody: This action will immediately suspend the provider profile. They will no longer receive service requests.
providers.deactivateHint: Help us understand why you are leaving...
providers.payoutNote: Pending payouts will be processed on the next cycle. Ensure banking details are up to date.
providers.suspendedBody: This provider account has been temporarily suspended due to multiple unfulfilled service requests.
providers.requiredActionBody: To restore status, review recent service logs and submit an appeal.

providers.regionCard: We need to know where you work.
